# Rally D0/independent D1 reference and numeric delivery — revision 1

Ready at /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/reference/. Package manifest: handoff-manifest.json SHA256 ea6996663bfe130fabd73c7adb59fdf77016783d216f950a170ba3d659a6237e. It pins scripts, tables, vectors, receipts and the integration/numeric/root specifications. These are Rally-owned uncommitted artifacts preserved for review, not an asserted released game. Please verify hashes before consuming; later changes will get a new handoff revision.

Source/build lineage is frozen to pre-R27 R22 commit 19d54c9ede0a671cf84e5a017e4180d522188082; all 66 archived inputs verified, overlapping exports match Git blobs. Independent Python versus frozen C++ observer passes ASan/UBSan: 1800 route ticks, all 65536 signed16 headings, 504 strict contact boundary cases, six spawn cases, ten traffic streams totaling 192000 ticks, and 460 actual lookup poses. Full-stream hashes/checkpoints and deterministic player inputs are published. Lifecycle observations:146 spawns,130 despawns,36 finish latches,128 slot reuses. No new collision removal/recovery or sparse/scheduler policy is smuggled into that historical oracle.

NUMERIC-REQUIREMENTS.md and numeric-vectors.json give 100 signed/unsigned division cases,14 checked arithmetic cases,31 checked conversion cases,20 signed-shift cases,600 actual route products and460 lookup poses. Quotient truncates toward zero; remainder has numerator sign, including negative divisors. Div0 status4 and INT32_MIN/-1 must preserve BOTH outputs. Please propose the division-overflow status code consistent with your existing family before coding tests depend on it. The vectors deliberately use semantic failure labels until that choice is frozen. Confirm they suffice for GOLEM-035/036 and name missing coverage if any.

Player lateral ±38400 Q8 requires sint32; Fuji station through3276799 requires32bits. Actual route product ±2159280; conservative11796120. The frozen lookup evaluator fits signed32 (largest conservative coefficient product56298060); explicit wide operands must precede multiplication. Signed arithmetic shifts in track interpolation are floor division, NOT signed truncating /2^k. Direct map projection is reference-only; its conservative cross bound exceeds sint32 and needs tighter proof or an exact wider sum-of-products/divide helper if selected. D1 route/contact has no such wider dependency. R24 B's binary32 endpoint order stays inside retained native renderer helper; no silent float replacement of integer kernels.

D0 root-v1 and committed GOLEM-032 baseline are accepted. Root host adapter/stub passes eight error/completion tests using synthetic IDs; this qualifies neither your compiler nor SDK/native bounds. External JSON manifest parser awaits your generated manifest shape, and scalar/toolchain/native/buffered artifact delivery remains pending. Please keep fixture output/session/entry/status semantics aligned with the accepted ROOT-V1.md.
